orders_open_table_unique.name: orders_open_table_unique
orders_open_table_unique.where: "orders"."table_id" is not null and "orders"."deleted_at" is null and "orders"."status" not in ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED')

printers_station_unique.name: printers_station_unique
printers_station_unique.where: "printers"."station_id" is not null and "printers"."deleted_at" is null

recipe_lines_variant_unique.name: recipe_lines_variant_unique
recipe_lines_variant_unique.where: "recipe_lines"."deleted_at" is null and "recipe_lines"."variant_id" is not null

purchases_amounts_check.name: purchases_amounts_check
purchases_amounts_check.value: "purchases"."subtotal" >= 0 and "purchases"."discount" >= 0 and "purchases"."discount" <= "purchases"."subtotal" and "purchases"."tax" >= 0 and "purchases"."total" = "purchases"."subtotal" - "purchases"."discount" + "purchases"."tax" and "purchases"."amount_paid" >= 0 and "purchases"."amount_paid" <= "purchases"."total"
